provenance.notes: No third party: the codes are computed and checked on the site's server (RFC 6238, over spomky-labs/otphp, MIT), the secrets sealed with the site's own sodium key; nothing is called, so there is no rate limit ([]) and no key of an account. The licence is the library's (MIT, its notice kept in vendor/ as Composer installs it). The tries a visitor may make are omniauth's Throttle ('totp': 5 every 15 minutes per account by default), an authentication rule of the site's, not a usage policy: this file limits nothing.
